children: RNS Number : 0129V  Bank of Nova Scotia  16 September 2026
The following securities of the Issuer have been admitted to trading on 16 September 2026 on the London Stock Exchange's main market:

GBP 1,250,000,000 Floating Rate Covered Bonds due March 2030, Series CBL76 (ISIN: XS3506171670) (the "Series CBL76 Covered Bonds") and GBP 750,000,000 5.125 per cent. Covered Bonds due 15 December 2032, Series CBL77 (ISIN: XS3506172645) (the "Series CBL77 Covered Bonds" and, together with the Series CBL76 Covered Bonds, the "Covered Bonds"), issued under the CAD100,000,000,000 Global Registered Covered Bond Program of the Issuer, unconditionally and irrevocably guaranteed as to payments of interest and principal by Scotiabank Covered Bond Guarantor Limited Partnership.

Full information on the Issuer and the offer of the Series CBL76 Covered Bonds is only available on the basis of the combination of the final terms for the Series CBL76 Covered Bonds published by the Issuer on 11 September 2026 (the "Series CBL76 Final Terms") and the base prospectus for the Program dated 5 August 2026 (the "Base Prospectus").

Full information on the Issuer and the offer of the Series CBL77 Covered Bonds is only available on the basis of the combination of the final terms for the Series CBL77 Covered Bonds published by the Issuer on 11 September 2026 (the "Series CBL77 Final Terms" and together with the Series CBL76 Final Terms, the "Final Terms Documents") and the Base Prospectus.
The Base Prospectus is available for viewing on the Issuer's website at: BNS-CB-2026-Update-Base-Prospectus-2026-Update-Final.pdf

Please note that the information contained in the Prospectus and the Final Terms Documents may be addressed to and/or targeted at persons who are residents of particular countries (specified in the Prospectus) only and is not intended for use and should not be relied upon by any person outside these countries and/or to whom the offer contained in the Final Terms Documents is not addressed.  Prior to relying on the information contained in the Prospectus and the Final Terms Documents you must ascertain from the Prospectus, as supplemented by these Final Terms, whether or not you are part of the intended addressees of the information contained therein.

In particular, neither the Prospectus nor the Final Terms Documents have been and will not be registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "Securities Act") or the securities laws of any state of the United States.  Accordingly, the Covered Bonds will be offered only in offshore transactions to non-US persons in reliance upon Regulation S under the Securities Act.  This announcement does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation to buy securities in the US or in any other jurisdiction where such offer or solicitation would be unlawful.
